official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description:
Image to 3D turns one photo, or a short description of a single object, into a textured 3D model you can preview right in the chat and download as a GLB file.

How it works: upload a photo of an object or describe one, and ask for a 3D model. The model is usually ready in one to three minutes, shown in an interactive viewer in the conversation, and offered as a GLB download that opens in most 3D viewers, Blender, game engines and slicers that support it.

Two qualities: Pro (Trellis 2) for more detail, Quick (Rodin 2.5 Fast) when speed matters more. Every generation uses the credits of the Image to 3D account you connect; the chat tells you what a model used and how many credits are left, and you can ask for your balance at any time.

Connecting takes a moment: press Connect, then enter the six-digit code in the Image to 3D app, under Settings. On a phone the connect page can open the app for you. You can disconnect from the app or from ChatGPT at any time.

Good to know: one object per model, photographed or described on its own, gives the best result. The plugin does not edit, convert or inspect existing 3D files, and it does not generate scenes with several objects. Photos and descriptions are processed by our generation partners to create the model; see the privacy policy for details.
